description:
FILED s517b (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-16) from the IO-Compress census (#3161).  PRE-EXISTING: main dc87c403 crashes the same probe.

REPRO (perl 5.40.3 prints ok 1 - a / ok 2 - no warnings):
  use Test::More; BEGIN { require Test::NoWarnings; Test::NoWarnings->import; plan tests => 2; } ok(1, "a");
PCL: ok 1 - no warnings / no plan / SBCL backtrace (unhandled condition).

LIKELY CAUSE (not probed further): PCL's Test::More is supplied by the runtime (CLAUDE.md, shipped-modules step 3) while Test::NoWarnings loads the real Test::Builder and calls its methods on the shared singleton, so `plan` receives the wrong invocant / argument shape.  The fix layer is the Test::Builder bridge, not zlib.

IMPACT: IO-Compress-2.214-0 cannot be measured at all (0 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 93 FAIL, every file 0 rows): scratch/s517b/io-compress-rows.tsv in the s517b worktree.

=== DONE (s519b) ===
Commit 1b7e5d12 (rebased 64158314): `Test::Builder` is in *p-pcl-provided-modules* (the TAP layer supplies it; perl's Test2-based module is never loaded); the builder object answers ok / diag / note / plan / done_testing / current_test from the TAP layer's own counter and plan (setting current_test dies, rule 12); the plan-count check is an END block registered when the layer loads, so a later module's END assertion (Test::NoWarnings' "no warnings" row) runs BEFORE it, as perl's Test::Builder `_ending` does.  The repro (`require Test::NoWarnings; Test::NoWarnings->import; plan tests => 2; ok(1)`) prints perl's output.  Guard Pl/t/universal-01.t row 14.  docs/shipped-modules.md step 3.
IMPACT: IO-Compress-2.214 is measurable: the s519b census (cpan-scoreboard over the dist, final tree) reads 10 PASS / 52 PARTIAL / 31 FAIL of 93, 1,852 ok / 149 not ok (it was 0 / 0 / 93 FAIL, every file 0 rows).  The board join and its rows: see the s519b report.
